source_snapshot.items: US.1_USB BMC to HMC USB Hub functional
source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC-to-HMC USB Hub link and show all downstream devices.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_USB_BMC_to_HMC; 30 attended/30 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; filtered host lsusb plus operator physical check, without an authoritative enumeration owner or complete downstream oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; identified the source conflict between all-downstream Procedure coverage and hub-only PASS Criteria.

old_problem: The Procedure requires the intended hub and every downstream device, while the Criteria grants PASS for detecting a hub alone. These scopes can yield opposite verdicts. A generic filtered host hub listing also cannot prove the BMC-to-HMC route.
disposition_reason: ED-19 forbids reducing distinct coverage, and no approved ED-01 through ED-30 ruling authorizes ignoring the Procedure. Although a parameterized topology collection can gather both evidence sets, the authoritative PASS/FAIL scope remains contradictory: hub-only detection can pass with missing downstream functions. This unresolved source conflict is genuine and must remain Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2169, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2170 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00057-V002 / d09323e52788fef5 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Engineer must decide whether PASS requires the exact hub only or the exact hub plus every downstream device named by the Procedure; until then collect and preserve both scopes.
Bind BMC controller/root-port/connectors to the HMC hub, authoritative native/proxy enumeration surface and stable hub VID:PID/product/serial/path/speed.
Freeze the complete downstream manifest with port/path/speed and missing/unexpected policy.
Operator verifies/photographs the physical link; software captures unfiltered topology, full descriptors and reset/error history.
No generic hub match, sshpass/host-key bypass, grep/head truncation, replug, reset, authorize/deauthorize, rebind, power cycle or retry.
No topology query, physical manipulation, USB state change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: BMC-to-HMC USB hub and complete downstream topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Prove the physical BMC-to-HMC USB path, exact hub identity and full downstream population while preserving both conflicting source acceptance scopes for engineer disposition.
required_package: Authoritative BMC controller/root-port/connector-to-HMC-hub map and enumeration owner
Exact hub identity/path/speed and complete downstream per-port manifest
Engineer decision on hub-only versus full-downstream PASS scope
Operator physical inspection/photos and usbutils/full descriptor access
USB reset/error limits, management-impact abort and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Operator confirms the physical route. On the authoritative surface, collect complete unfiltered USB tree, hub and downstream descriptors plus reset/error history; compare exact hub and every manifest child separately. Report both hub-only and full-downstream results without issuing a verdict or changing USB state.
test_case.expected_result: Evidence proves the exact physical/logical hub route and separately identifies every expected/missing/unexpected/moved/downgraded child; final PASS awaits the approved acceptance scope, and no USB or management instability occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while source scopes conflict. Under a future ruling, apply the signed hub identity and, if Procedure coverage is retained, every downstream manifest item. Wrong route/hub, missing required device or reset/error breach is FAIL under the applicable scope; missing ruling is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED for verdict until acceptance scope, topology and manifest are signed.
Read-only collection only; operator handles physical inspection without replug.
No filtered/generic hub match, reset, rebind, authorize/deauthorize, power action or retry.
Stop on reset storm, flapping, wrong path or BMC/HMC instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and conflict disposition
BMC-to-HMC physical map and operator photos
Authoritative unfiltered USB tree plus complete hub/downstream descriptors and speeds
Frozen manifest comparison listing every present/missing/unexpected/moved device
Pre/post reset/error/flap and BMC/HMC health evidence
Separate hub-only/full-downstream outcomes, recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve topology/error evidence on instability. Leave the management USB path unchanged and use only the owner-approved recovery; do not replug, reset, rebind or retry to alter the observed result.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure requires all downstream devices; Criteria says hub detection alone passes. The two authoritative acceptance scopes remain unreconciled.

blocked.reason: Evidence collection is feasible, but final acceptance remains Engineering Decision Pending due the unresolved source conflict.
